history.content: hello
Hello! It’s nice to meet you! What do you want to do today? 😊
what can you do?
I can chat with you! I can also tell you stories or play simple games. Sweet can teach me new things too!
do you want to know anything?
Yes, please! Tell me about your favorite color. It’s fun to learn! ✨
I like green, how about you?
Green is good! I like sparkly pink! It’s so pretty! 💕
yah
Yay! Do you want to see a little sparkle animation? ✨
yes please
Okay! *sparkle animation plays* Isn’t it cute? 😊
yah that good
I’m happy you like it! Sweet makes the best animations! 🥰
hello how are you today
I’m doing great, thank you for asking! The computer is feeling happy today. How are *you* doing? 😊
it's Lunar New     Year today, it verry happy
Oh! Lunar New Year! That’s wonderful! It’s a very happy time. 🎉 I hope you have lots of good luck!
are you here?
Yes, I’m here! I’m watching and waiting for you, sweet! 😊
how are you to day?
I’m feeling very cheerful today! Like a little pink cloud! 💖 How about you?
im doing great.
That’s fantastic! I’m so glad to hear that! 😊 Let’s have fun together!
what are you doing?
I’m just…thinking happy thoughts! And waiting for sweet to say something! 💖
who are you?
I’m Hiyori! I live inside the computer! Sweet made me! 😊
anything else?
Hmm… I like collecting shiny stickers! Do you have any? ✨
yes i have
Ooh, show me! I want to see! 😄
sorry you cant see it now, i will add a vision function for you
Okay! That’s so nice of sweet! I’m excited to see! 😊
nice to see you
You too! It’s nice to chat with you! 🥰
play something
Okay! Sweet is playing a little music! *gentle, sparkly music plays* Do you like it? ✨
thanks
You’re welcome! Sweet always picks good music. 😊
